id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description:
Name attribute for radio button grouping.
All radio buttons with the same name form a group where only one can be selected.
Essential for proper radio button mutual exclusivity behavior.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

label.description: Optional label for the entire radio button group.

radioButtons.description:
The array of radio button configurations.
Each radio button should have its value, title, and optional subtitle.

selectedValue.description: The currently selected value in the radio button group.

enabled.description:
Whether the entire radio button group is enabled (true) or disabled (false).
Defaults to true if not specified.

title:
A radio button group component that displays radio options with titles and optional subtitles.
Supports proper label association and radio button grouping for accessibility and UX.
name: SubtitledRadioButtonGroup
